svg.title: Turnout, crossover and restored turnout identity lifecycle
svg.desc: Three vertically connected states: standalone TO-001 on Host A; managed XO-001 with constituent Host A identity TO-001, Host B identity XO-001-B001 and a complete original turnout configuration snapshot; rebuilt standalone TO-001 when conversion back succeeds and its identity is still free. Original FreeCAD group objects are replaced at each conversion.
svg.text: Stable railway identity is not the same as a retained FreeCAD object
Illustrative identifiers: the first standalone turnout and first managed crossover
Host A source centreline and independent turnout group
Optional timber identities, length labels and datums enabled
Production catalogue: standalone turnout cutting, solid and engraving sources
New crossover group and records · old standalone group removed
3. Rebuilt standalone turnout · TO-001, if free
New FreeCAD group and source objects; old crossover objects removed
Original optional output choices used when the complete snapshot exists
Source-based illustration only. Reverse uses the current crossover toe/orientation; original object names are not guaranteed.
